summary: A candidate learns what a rival's side mailed about them from someone who received it, not from the rival.
realLife: In Sandy, Utah, mailers aimed at a council candidate went to residents first, and the town's mayor then called them illegal. The targeted candidate dealt with them after neighbors had seen them.
sources: KSL, Sandy calling for an end to illegal mailers targeting a candidate for City Council: https://www.ksl.com/article/50762369/sandy-calling-for-an-end-to-illegal-mailers-targeting-a-candidate-for-city-council
KPBS, candidates trade attack mailers and texts in San Diego council races: https://www.kpbs.org/news/2020/oct/22/candidates-trade-attack-mailers-texts-san-diego-ci
